5/S0.subgoal: Explain the basic dictionary definition of Augmented Reality (AR) and its underlying components.

5/S1.subgoal: Describe the three primary characteristics required by the systemic definition of an AR system.

5/S2.subgoal: Analyze the detailed components (technology, 3D registration, sensory organs, and interaction) that define an AR system.

5/S3.subgoal: Compare and contrast Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) by examining their defining characteristics and a practical example.

5/S4.subgoal: Review the various definitions of Mixed Reality (MR) and state the working assumption used in the course.

5/S5.subgoal: Summarize the key concepts, characteristics, and main differences between VR, AR, and MR systems discussed in the lecture.

5/S6.subgoal: Conclude the lecture and identify the topics that will be covered in subsequent lessons.
